samples.name: terrain-pond-water
samples.prompt: ONE square opaque game terrain tile. Style references: image 1 Tiny Town, image 2 Tiny Farm. Match their very simple flat pixel-art terrain. Design at exactly 16x16 logical pixels, uniformly enlarged. Large square pixel blocks only, absolutely no gradients, microtexture, lighting or antialiasing. Top-down, full bleed, no border, no text, no surrounding background. Palette: grass #78B85A, darker grass #579548, pond #5C9F9A, shallow #91C4B2, sand #CFB57C. Still greener-blue pond water, exactly one small dark-green lily pad with a little V notch near center. Very sparse short light ripples. All outer edges flat pond color; seamless.
